sources.source_name: Sony: The acquisition of entertainment businesses
sources.notes: Undated retrospective company history: CBS Records January 1988, Columbia Pictures November 1989, film box-office performance through 1993, and a 265.2 billion yen film-business write-down in fiscal 1994. Each scenario uses only facts before its endpoint.
Indexed original archive report consulted: about $2.7 billion film-business write-down, distinct from the reported $3.2 billion quarterly loss.
Filed annual report: worldwide unit-case volume grew 5% in 1993; international markets produced 79% of operating income. These are volume and operating-income measures, not stock-return measures.

sources.source_name: Oil & Gas Journal: Profits for OGJ group show big gain in 1993, revenues dip
sources.notes: 1994 contemporary industry review; exact publication day not established. Exxon refining and marketing earnings rose 28% to $2.015 billion in 1993, helped by margins and lower costs. For January 1994 endpoints, cited retrospectively for the completed 1993 operating year, not as news already published at the endpoint.
